Dentist: Any discomfort? Patient: Only when drinking something very cold.

Fencer: Another round? Opponent: After we adjust the distance.
Counselor: What would help? Visitor: A little more time.
Florist: Shall I include a card? Buyer: Leave it blank.
Sailmaker: Can this tear be patched? Owner: The fabric remains strong.
Dentist: Shall we take a break? Patient: Just a moment.
Midwife: Have you brought the paperwork? Parent: In this folder.
Puppeteer: Why did the scene stop? Helper: A string tangled.
Optician: Which frame feels lighter? Customer: The narrower metal one.

Petition status: signatures verified; decision pending; hearing next month.

Multiplying two negative numbers produces a positive result.
A pentagon has five diagonals connecting nonadjacent vertices.
The logarithm of one equals zero for any valid base.
A complete binary tree has at most two children per node.
The empty set contains no elements at all.
A probability cannot be smaller than zero or greater than one.
A factorial counts the possible arrangements of distinct objects.
A permutation treats order as meaningful when arranging objects.
A combination disregards order when selecting objects from a group.
The common logarithm of a thousand equals three.
An isosceles triangle has at least two equal sides.
A regular tetrahedron has four triangular faces.
The remainder must be smaller than a positive integer divisor.
A parallelogram has opposite sides that are equal in length.
A nonzero number divided by itself equals one.
An irrational number cannot equal a ratio of two integers.

Her unfinished scarf seemed to be knitting the winter itself.
A chess knight stood patiently at the edge of possibility.
The abandoned greenhouse held summer hostage beneath its broken panes.
His apology arrived wearing the awkward clothes of a joke.
A gramophone offered its dusty flowers of sound.
The snowfall turned every parked car into an unfamiliar hill.
Her wedding dress rustled with the voices of earlier fittings.
A stubborn comma kept the sentence from saying goodbye.
The fishing float nodded politely to the passing current.
The worn staircase carried a family history in its shallow grooves.
His spectacles rested on the book like a sleeping question.
The vacant aquarium held only an ocean of lamplight.
A crease divided the photograph into two incompatible summers.
Her footsteps gave the empty corridor a temporary purpose.
The tangled yarn promised a warmer shape than its present confusion.
